full_name: Arij Daou | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Biological Sciences Radcliffe Fellow American University of Beirut (Lebanon)
bio: Arij Daou is a neuroscientist and biomedical engineer whose work brings together electrophysiology, computational modeling, and machine learning to explore how the brain gives rise to learned sequences, from the patterned beauty of birdsong to the intricacy of human speech.
